title: Come Experience The High Altitude Light Blast & See AW Speak At The Gaia HEAL Conference
text: I'm with Kelly gors my dear friend right here we're going to talk about the Gaia heel conference yes which is really incredible so what are we doing at this conference it's the first finally live event we're doing it with Gia at the Gaia Spirit B to Colorado it's November 9th and 10th so it's only a few weeks away a few tickets are left so click the links in our bio to buy some tickets and be there in the flesh with medical Medium you're going to want to be there because I'm going to talk about some really crazy stuff like for real it's going to be off the hook I'm letting you guys know that because it's not the same thing all right this is different I don't usually do the lecture circuit so much cuz I'm busy writing the books busy doing all kinds of stuff I got them down you got you got me there so I'm making sure that that talk is going to blow people's minds like blow their minds I'm going to say some things I'm probably going to regret but that's okay true medical medium fashion that's what I do I'm going to talk about life-changing stuff on a whole different level things you can do when you can't sleep good that's going to blow your mind I'm going to talk about some other different healing tools but it's going to be really really enlightening I'm doing a light blast as well from s so people are just going to be blown away and they're going to feel it right down to the crown of their head down to their bottom of their feet it's going to be really mindblowing and you're going to be talking which is going to be incredible you got aw there there's other incredible speakers it's going to be that powerful and that good yeah who doesn't want to go to Colorado who doesn't want to go to Colorado Okay I want to go to Colorado so I going to be there it's going to be amazing make sure you guys are there if you can be there click the link at the bio we'll see you there [Music]
